member.name: F:NuGet.Commands.BuildAssetsUtils.PermanentNuGetToolsVersionValue
member.summary:
This value is written into generated Restore props files, but if it changes across tooling that ships different NuGet versions (like Visual Studio and the dotnet CLI) it can cause unintentional problems with MSBuild incrementality. As a result, we set it to a new, fixed value higher than the current NuGet version (6.14.x) and never change it again, so that starting in .NET 10 onwards this won't cause rebuilds.
We could remove the property entirely, but there are some uses of it on public GitHub that aren't just from checked-in generated files, so keeping it around but stable is the most compatible option.
